# Help pages that still carry a spec citation or an issue number, and exactly which
# references and how many (revision hashes are banned outright and are not listed).
# cli#2525. A ratchet per reference: a page may carry fewer of a reference, never more,
# and never one that is not listed; a listed reference the page no longer carries must
# be removed. Shrink it with
#   go test ./internal/cmd -run TestHelpCarriesNoNewCitationsNumbersOrHashes2525 -update-citation-exceptions
# which never adds. A renamed command's entry moves with
#   go test ./internal/cmd -run TestHelpCarriesNoNewCitationsNumbersOrHashes2525 -rename-citation-exception 'old page=>new page'
# (never by hand). Line: <page>  # <kind> <reference> x<count> | ...
# The scrub is tracked in https://github.com/hadron-memory/hadron-cli/issues/2811, by group.
